rules: Brown & Tan merged into Earthy (no Brown & Tan section).

Neutral & Ivory = light & quiet (cream, ivory, soft gray, linen). Earthy = muted/low-saturation incl. browns, tan, olive, rust, tortoise, leather. Dark & Moody = deep rich saturated darks (navy, emerald, burgundy, black-ground florals; jewel box, not muted). Black & White = crisp graphic contrast (stripes, checks, toile in black/white).

Holiday = true Christmas/holiday motifs only (Santa, trees, ornaments, wreaths, candy canes, snowflakes, reindeer, gifts, 'merry/noel/sleigh' text, Hanukkah, fall/Valentine seasonal motifs). Red/green/plaid mats with no motifs are year-round and go in their color sections.
Only label a mat Retired when it is confirmed gone for good; a mat missing from a store's listing gets no shop button and no Retired label.
Jungle mats (dense tropical foliage / jungle scenes) are Green first, other colors as also-tags (crosstags 'jungle'). Her own calls still win (e.g. Mahj & Moon Tropical Leopard stays Purple).

Multi-Pastel replaced by a broader 'Pastels' section: any mat whose overall palette is pastel (soft, light, low-to-mid saturation), single-color or multi; extra tag only. Think Sorbet, Luminaire, Taylor, Coquette tile sets.

Mood tags: Pastels (soft/light, single or multi) and Brights (bold, saturated, clean). Every mat without a Neutral/Earthy/Dark/B&W tag lands in Pastels or Brights. The plain Multicolor section is retired (its mats moved by tone); Multicolor Florals stays.
Chip order: colors, Neutral & Ivory, Earthy, Dark & Moody, Black & White, Pastels, Brights, Multicolor Florals, Animal Prints, Holiday, Retired.
